items.text: Stuck on a puzzle but don't want the solution handed to you?

The new Soft Hint system is designed to give you a gentle nudge in the right direction without spoiling the satisfaction of figuring things out yourself. It's not a walkthrough, but rather a little help when you need it.
You can access hints directly from your in-game Journal, whenever you decide you'd like a clue.
We're excited to welcome Portuguese-speaking players to Verice Bay! Whirlight will now be fully playable in Portuguese.
We're also adding full Turkish localization, making the adventure accessible to even more players around the world.
We've polished a number of small interactions and made various improvements to make your adventure a little smoother.
As always, we've squashed a number of bugs and addressed issues reported by the community.
Thank you to everyone who has played Whirlight, shared feedback, and reported bugs since launch. Every message helps us improve the game, and we hope you'll enjoy this latest update.
See you in Verice Bay...and remember, the best adventures sometimes need just the tiniest hint.

items.text: We’ve just released Patch 03 for Whirlight, bringing improvements to compatibility, localization, usability, and a number of fixes based on feedback from players!
Improved video encoding for better compatibility across devices
Added fan-made Russian translation support (many thanks to Igor "Amigaser" Lap on our Discord community ❤️)
Tutorial update: double-click interaction explained
Various quality-of-life improvements
Bug fixes and stability improvements
We’ve also made a number of smaller adjustments based on player feedback, including:
translation fixes
updates to the credits with community testers
improvements to minigame interaction areas
save system stability improvements.
A big thank you to everyone who has been reporting issues and helping us improve Whirlight since launch. It genuinely makes a difference for a small team like ours.
If you encounter anything odd after the update, let us know in the discussions 💙
